description: WebMCP Retail demo — accessories store with WebMCP + AG-UI custom agent support

tools.name: login
tools.title: Login
tools.description: Signs the user in via PingOne. Ask the user for their account email address in chat first, then pass it as the email parameter. The tab navigates to the PingOne sign-in, the user completes out-of-band verification there (e.g. approving on their phone), and the app reloads signed in — the store tools then become available. Only usable when signed out.

email.description: The user's email address — ask the user for it in chat before calling this tool.

tools.name: view_products
tools.title: View Products
tools.description: Fetches the product catalog from the backend API. Requires an active user session.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.title: Add to Cart
tools.description: Adds a product to the shopping cart by product ID and quantity.

tools.name: view_cart
tools.title: View Cart
tools.description: Returns the current cart contents and total as JSON. Requires an active user session.

tools.name: remove_from_cart
tools.title: Remove from Cart
tools.description: Removes a product entirely from the cart by product ID. Dynamically registered — only available when the cart contains items.

tools.name: checkout
tools.title: Checkout
tools.description: POSTs the cart to the checkout API using the user's access_token as a Bearer credential. The host prompts the user for confirmation (consequentialHint) before this tool runs. If the policy requires step-up, returns a challenge: MFA_REQUIRED (ask the user for the OTP from their email, then call verify_checkout_otp) or VERIFY_TRANSACTION (user approves in PingOne Verify, then call check_checkout_verification). Dynamically registered — only available when the cart contains items.

tools.name: verify_checkout_otp
tools.title: Verify Checkout OTP
tools.description: Completes checkout after an MFA_REQUIRED challenge. Pass the one-time code the user received by email (ask the user for it in chat). Dynamically registered while an MFA challenge is pending.

otpCode.description: The one-time code the user received (4-8 digits) — ask the user for it in chat.

tools.name: check_checkout_verification
tools.title: Check Checkout Verification
tools.description: Checks whether the user has approved the pending PingOne Verify transaction (QR scan). Poll this tool — e.g. every 10 seconds — until it returns success or an error. Dynamically registered while a Verify transaction is pending.
